859036724717.name: Corporate Banking Associate (Assistant Vice President)
859036724717.job_description:
At Citi, we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day. And we've been doing it for more than 200 years. We do this through our unparalleled global network.

Citi Corporate Bank serves as the conduit of Citi’s full product suite to clients through holistically managed relationships across our unparalleled network.

We’re seeking an Associate to join our Australian Corporate Banking team in Sydney. This role offers an opportunity to support Top Tier Local Corporate (TTLC) clients, make informed lending decisions to support business development, and contribute to the overall success of Citi’s Banking franchise.

The successful candidate will have previous experience in a banking setting, with working knowledge of corporate finance, and understanding of client needs across a range of banking products and services.

The successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of Citi’s organizational structure, support existing client needs, coordinate delivery of Citi’s extensive product suite, and ensure exceptional client relationship management, while adhering to all credit, regulatory and internal compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management

  • Support Senior Bankers on a portfolio of key corporate clients

  • Monitor key market, industry and economics trends and how it influences clients’ strategic objectives and financial needs

  • Build and develop client relationships with key stakeholders to support long-term growth of the franchise

Business Development

  • Support pitching activities to deliver cross-sell across Banking, Markets, and Services

  • Collaborate with product partners and global teams to deliver integrated solutions to our clients

  • Achieve financial objectives by leveraging Citi’s full spectrum of products and services

Credit Risk Management

  • Work in partnership with Institutional Credit Management & Underwriting to ensure credit requirements are met

  • Act as an escalation point for clients and liaising with internal teams where required to ensure Operations and Product are taking the appropriate steps and responsibility to resolve items raised by the clients.

  • Ensure continuous adherence to credit, risk and regulatory requirements for Citi's lending activities

Network Management

  • Coordinate with Products teams to ensure appropriate credit limits are in place to support client activities

  • Support the co-ordination and execution of day - to - day credit requests from Citi's Global Network Bankers all around the world

  • Act as an escalation point for clients and liaising with internal teams where required to ensure Operations and Product are taking the appropriate steps and responsibility to resolve items raised by the clients.  Escalate internally when required.

Skills and Experiences Required:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in corporate banking, capital markets, advisory or a related financial services role, with a focus on large corporate clients

  • Foundational knowledge of corporate finance principles, capital markets, and transaction banking products

  • Strong credit analysis skills and a solid understanding of risk management

  • Track record of supporting the execution of financial transactions, especially lending and capital markets

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to develop client relationships at a junior level

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with independence and across a diverse team

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

859037315605.name: Asia Regional Commercial Cards Sales Manager, Services – Vice President - SYDNEY
859037315605.posting_name: Asia Regional Commercial Cards Sales Manager, Services – Vice President - SYDNEY
859037315605.job_description:
Position Summary

Citi is seeking an experienced Commercial Cards Sales Manager to be based in Sydney (Australia) , The individual will focus on driving Commercial Cards Sales with a focus on the Australia and New Zealand markets and will be part of the APAC Commercial Cards Regional Sales team. This is a senior sales role focused on originating and growing Citi's Commercial Cards business with a strategic emphasis on Australia and New Zealand headquartered names - targeting both existing and prospective institutional clients.

About Citi Services & Commercial Cards

Citi Services offers a comprehensive suite of cash management and trade services to institutional clients worldwide. Citi's global platform is distinguished by its reach, interoperability, and flexibility —-empowering clients to effectively manage their financial positions, working capital, and supply chains across the globe.

Citi Commercial Cards is a marquee product line within the global Services business. Citi is the world's most global issuer of Commercial Cards, with the capability to issue local-currency solutions in 59 countries through its proprietary platforms and issuance infrastructure. The business has grown at or above industry rates in recent years, with Asia representing one of the most significant and sustained growth opportunities globally. The Services Cards business supports comprehensive solutions across Travel, B2B, E-commerce,  Purchasing, and Meetings & Events.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the origination and growth of new Commercial Cards business with focus on Australia and New Zealand HQ names.
  • Identify and develop new sales opportunities, building a robust pipeline across new products, geographies, and client segments — with a primary focus on Travel and B2B Commercial Card flows.
  • Proactively execute initiatives to capture new payment flows within the target segments
  • Collaborate with Services Sales and Banking partners to accelerate deal origination and provide effective sales support
  • Actively manage won deals to deliver a positive client experience throughout implementation, ensuring revenues ramp on schedule and escalating issues to senior stakeholders where necessary
  • Align with and champion regional Card Sales priorities and strategic initiatives
  • Analyse client spend data and translate insights into actionable growth and development recommendations
  • Meet or exceed annual new business win targets and revenue goals for net-new client wallet acquisition

Why Join Citi – Development Value

  • Join one of the fastest-growing businesses within Citi globally
  • Build and sharpen business development and strategic sales skills
  • Gain exposure to a dynamic, multi-regional environment and diverse client base
  • Drive client-centric innovation with tangible impact
  • Expand scope and responsibilities within Services and the broader Citi organisation

Qualifications & Experience

Required Knowledge & Experience

  • Good understanding of commercial card products, the competitive landscape, and target client profiles
  • Demonstrated experience in corporate sales (large corporates or mid-market clients) within banking or financial services

Core Skills

  • Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills, with confidence engaging C-suite stakeholders both at client organisations and internally at Citi
  • Strong consultative selling and negotiation capabilities
  • Creative problem-solving ability to develop innovative, client-tailored solutions
  • Proven relationship-building skills across cross-functional and cross-regional teams
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders toward shared objectives

Education & Experience Requirements

  • ~10+ years of industry sales experience, preferably within the large corporate or mid-market sector
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (advanced degree preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively at senior levels, internally and externally
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively within a global matrix organisation
